lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular nodes forming three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with spatial spacing roughly equidistant between central nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge originates above the gill slits and extends posteriorly along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a pronounced luminance transition from high (upper) to shadow (lower).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear high-luminance mark is present on the upper mid-flank posterior to the gills. A clear transverse white scar is visible on the distal portion of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of micro-blobs is present on the anterior cephalic region, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs posteriorly.
